final.confidence_method: one-sided Clopper-Pearson beta lower with Bonferroni over six candidate-family claims
final.seed_protocol: SeedSequence spawn 6 independent streams in candidate-major/family-minor order
final.on_fail: retain failed result; do not change seeds, append labels, widen candidates or re-use validation to certify changed model
final.sample_design: n4096 gives approximately .981 design power for p=.964297 under fixed6claims; no guarantee of pass
final.unknown_initial: never count as future hit or no_hit; failures remain denominator and block certification

delays.identity: hypothetical relative local shear origin; action0 isolates publication,5/15/30 sensitivity only; not observed response times

gp.test_protocol: all 600 midpoint cells; training on 601 edges; min distance .0025 m/s
gp.final_test_use: once after freeze; no retuning; numerical scenario test, not iid coverage certificate
gp.probability_identity: declared input families conditional on fixed Q2, not natural disaster probability
